methodology.selection: One line-preferred region per new work; at most 40 works per split/format considered, top 12 source-diversity scores and three seeded controls. All original and second-round candidate works excluded.
methodology.oracle: Assistant source-only visual review, background swatches and inspected blank source strips. Silver OCR boxes. Not human gold.
methodology.metric: Maximum absolute sRGB channel error <=25; absent observed background fails
methodology.split: Existing work-disjoint development/holdout partition is diagnostic only. Two development and two holdout annotations audited after predictions; algorithm development used a holdout failure. Final suite is reviewed regression data, not untouched holdout accuracy.
